versions.content: If the configuration parameter J1939DcmDevErrorDetect [ ECUC_J1939Dcm_00003 : ] is enabled, the function J1939Dcm_RequestIndication shall check if the channel parameter is configured (J1939DcmNodeChannelRef) for the requested node parameter. In case of an error, the function J1939Dcm_RequestIndication shall return without any effect and shall report the error to the Default Error Tracer with the error code J1939DCM_E_INVALID_CHANNEL.
